import java.io.BufferedReader;

import java.io.InputStreamReader;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputStream inStream = System.in;
        OutputStream outStream = System.out;
        ScannerWrapper scanner = new ScannerWrapper(inStream);
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(outStream);
        GeometrySolver solver = new GeometrySolver();
        solver.solve(1, scanner, writer);
        writer.close();
    }

    static class GeometrySolver {
        public static boolean isAngleLessThan90(Point a, Point b) {
            double magA = a.magnitude();
            double magB = b.magnitude();
            double dotProduct = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
            double angleDeg = Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(dotProduct / (magA * magB)));
            return angleDeg < 90;
        }

        public void solve(int testNumber, ScannerWrapper scanner, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = scanner.nextInt();
            if (n > 11) {
                out.println("0");
                return;
            }
            HashSet<Integer> candidates = new HashSet<>();
            ArrayList<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int a = scanner.nextInt();
                int b = scanner.nextInt();
                int c = scanner.nextInt();
                int d = scanner.nextInt();
                int e = scanner.nextInt();
                points.add(new Point(a, b, c, d, e));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                boolean isGood = true;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if (i != j && i != k && j != k) {
                            Point p1 = points.get(j);
                            Point p2 = points.get(k);
                            Point p3 = points.get(i);
                            Point vec1 = new Point(p1.v - p3.v, p1.w - p3.w, p1.x - p3.x, p1.y - p3.y, p1.z - p3.z);
                            Point vec2 = new Point(p2.v - p3.v, p2.w - p3.w, p2.x - p3.x, p2.y - p3.y, p2.z - p3.z);
                            if (isAngleLessThan90(vec1, vec2)) {
                                isGood = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (isGood) {
                    candidates.add(i + 1);
                }
            }
            if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
                out.println("0");
            } else {
                out.println(candidates.size());
                for (int index : candidates) {
                    out.println(index);
                }
            }
        }

        static class Point {
            int v, w, x, y, z;

            public Point(int v, int w, int x, int y, int z) {
                this.v = v;
                this.w = w;
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.z = z;
            }

            public double magnitude() {
                return Math.sqrt(v * v + w * w + x * x + y * y + z * z);
            }
        }
    }

    static class ScannerWrapper {
        BufferedReader reader;
        StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public ScannerWrapper(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
